definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.102) index: 'A storage area or a register, the content of which refers to a particular element in a table'; 2023 calls it a conceptual data item. GR1 tests the FROM identifier's value before the index is set, not the index's representation, so scope is unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.12.1.2: EC-RANGE-PERFORM-VARYING is Fatal in the 2002 table; with checking on and a USE declarative the declarative runs and, if it completes normally, the run unit ends abnormally; RESUME (§2002:14.8.31.3 GR2) continues after the statement. 2023 differs only by its PERFORM WHEN path and file items. ec_range_perform_varying (>>TURN on, USE declarative with RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT) re-run now PASSES at --std 2002, which is the 2002 behaviour.

band-formats.answer: The 2002 PERFORM has two formats, out-of-line and inline (§2002:14.8.27.1), with one unbanded syntax-rule list; they are 2023 formats 1 and 2 phrase for phrase (2023 adds UNTIL EXIT and format 3, both absent from 2002). The 2023 band FORMATS 1 AND 2 therefore reaches every 2002 PERFORM; no 2002 format falls outside it. GR1 governs index-name VARYING/AFTER with an identifier FROM in either format.
